timestampBasis: Recorded session windows; overlapping elapsed time is not summed effort.

events.promptKind: Exact excerpts from prompts within the same session
events.title: Launch the collection and first prototype
events.promptExcerpt:
I want to solve and build solutions to each of these programs, and have them as a showcase on my website.

Let's start with number one.

Don't worry about the PDF yet, that will be the final step once we have completed and polished all of the solutions.
events.outcome: Established the shared portfolio workspace and built the first agent-driven sensemaking prototype. The recorded result included six reusable tools, graph and multimodal evidence, a 24-tool-call synthetic run, and 34 passing checks.

events.promptExcerpt: Emphasize research and general planning right now. Build out the exact build and implementation roadmap with clear roadblocks.
events.title: Research the metadata discovery architecture
events.outcome: Created an eight-phase implementation roadmap with deliverables, dependencies, acceptance gates, and responses to corpus, metadata-release, use-case, and evaluation constraints. This session produced architecture and corpus research before implementation.

events.promptExcerpt: build and research first. See what already exists, what we could imitate, and build a build plan that we could plug any agent into
events.title: Research an interchangeable-agent architecture
events.outcome: Created a research brief and six-stage build plan connecting interchangeable agents through MCP/CLI tools to Elasticsearch, Kibana Maps, and CSV. Defined seven tool contracts and a first acceptance gate: query, export, and map must represent the same selection.

events.promptExcerpt: Do deep research initially to design and plan how we are going to build the solutions to this.
events.title: Research the organizational graph workflow
events.outcome: Designed ingestion, identity resolution, relationship inference, evidence review, corrections, and export. Compared research approaches and separated reporting, authority, teams, and influence in the proposed architecture.

events.promptExcerpt: Not yet, but let's build an implementation plan, project design, and then we can find a dataset that can be plugged in.
events.title: Design a pluggable temporal graph system
events.outcome: Designed pluggable datasets, temporal history, bounded graph retrieval, an analyst interface, and scale evaluation. Reviewed the design and checked its documentation.

events.promptExcerpt: Should we do a grill me to work through the plan first?
events.title: Pressure-test the project priorities
events.outcome: Opened a planning review comparing three outcomes: a reusable analytics backend, a compelling demonstration, and rigorous research evaluation.

events.promptExcerpt: I would like to do a batch grill me
events.title: Stress-test discovery and extraction decisions
events.outcome: Reviewed seven planning decisions covering discovery versus extraction, released metadata, corpus reuse, human review, offline operation, scope, and use-case mapping.

events.promptExcerpt: all three, but I would prefer 2, then 1, but 3 has to be robust.
events.title: Prioritize the backend and evaluation
events.outcome: Set the delivery order to reusable backend first, demonstration second, with rigorous evaluation throughout.
events.promptContext: Context summary: the numbered choices were demo (1), reusable analytics backend (2), and research result (3).

events.promptExcerpt: It needs to be able to be ran locally, but the computer I am running this on right now doesn't have the architecture to handle it so we need to design something that could scale based on available architecture.
events.title: Design for local, variable-capacity hardware
events.outcome: Established local execution and hardware-adaptive capacity as requirements. The planning response separated small-fixture development from validation on stronger hardware and kept the analytics backend independent of the agent provider.

events.title: Pause to interrogate the brief
events.promptExcerpt:
Is it too late to do batch grilling? Look up the batch grill me skill online, make sure that it is installed here, and then run it for this.

And then we can continue the development once grilling is complete
events.outcome: Paused implementation for a structured design interview: intended user, evidence standard, visitor experience, involvement, and cost constraints.

events.promptExcerpt: Needs to be designed to run offline
events.title: Commit to an offline metadata-only workflow
events.outcome: Revised the roadmap for offline extraction and natural-language discovery, with separate coverage-only and approved-value catalogs. Proposed a bounded real-manual pilot, reviewed examples, measured extraction errors, and reproducible evidence.

events.promptExcerpt: Eventually fully local, but for now we are just looking for a 'solve' based on the PDF that began these projects.
events.title: Separate scale ambitions from measured capacity
events.outcome: Requested substantial scale and an eventual fully local deployment. The planning response retained Elasticsearch/Kibana from the brief and proposed a billion-record design target with simulations, executed benchmarks, and measured capacity reported separately.

events.promptKind: Exact excerpts from the same prompt
events.title: Set the portfolio and cost constraints
events.promptExcerpt:
This needs to be a comprehensive portfolio that I could send and provide to someone when they ask for a showcase of my projects and skills.

Begin with synthetic, allow for two public databases of different scales, and a solution that theoretically scales infinitely.

There should be clear deliverables, why the solutions work, and access to the solutions for scrutiny.

This needs to be completely free, anything that needs to be solved should be solved, packaged, and completed by us.
events.outcome: Defined inspectable local software, synthetic-first evidence, two public data sources, and a zero-new-spending constraint. The agreed scaling statement became no fixed dataset ceiling with measured resource limits.

events.promptExcerpt: I trust you on this.
events.title: Finalize the implementation plan
events.outcome: Finalized self-hosted Elasticsearch/Kibana with a custom analytical layer, staged datasets, independent correctness checks, held-out questions, and repeated agent tests. The billion-record figure remained a design target.

events.promptExcerpt: This seems too simple. It needs to be completed in a robust and comprehensive way.
events.title: Expand the acceptance criteria
events.outcome: Expanded the plan to representative scans and layouts, model variants and revisions, evidence-linked corrections, recovery behavior, and independent unseen-document testing. Defined the small corpus as a pilot and separated automatic extraction results from reviewed results.

events.promptExcerpt: Build stronger completion, polish, inferred features and abilities.
events.title: Define analyst workflows and acceptance criteria
events.outcome: Expanded the design with team discovery, communication comparisons, review behavior, resumable runs, durable corrections, and reproducible exports. Specified 17 acceptance scenarios and completion gates.

events.promptExcerpt: Enhance the current build specs for this project, infer additional features and implied understanding.
events.title: Turn the brief into a testable specification
events.outcome: Expanded the specification with saved investigations, two baseline scopes, paired evidence, reversible reviews, exports, and explicit temporal behavior. Mapped 12 requirements to 31 acceptance scenarios and distinguished core from optional scope.

events.title: Approve the design and build the evidence workspace
events.promptExcerpt: agree all.
events.outcome: Approved the preceding design decisions and moved into implementation, evaluation, and packaging. The recorded checkpoint contained 13 inspectable cases, 268 passing tests, and a reproducible source package.
events.context: This approval refers to the preceding design interview: free local reproduction, explicit resource limits, research-organization cases, interactive examples plus local execution, and end-to-end implementation.

events.promptExcerpt: Build it
events.title: Build the first working analytical toolkit
events.outcome: Implemented the agent-neutral CLI/MCP interface, analytics, CSV export, ingestion, and map adapters. The final report recorded 149 passing tests, a verified agent demonstration, and simulation runs through 100,000 records.

events.promptExcerpt: Build hard and agressively.
events.title: Build the offline extraction and discovery system
events.outcome: Implemented OCR, evidence review, and metadata-only search with portable Windows runtimes bundling Python/OCR. The final report recorded 151 passing tests and a five-manual, 616-page corpus run that flagged six damaged pages.

events.promptExcerpt: go ahead and build
events.title: Build the organization analysis workspace
events.outcome: Built import, inference, evidence review, correction and undo, snapshot comparison, and export. Recorded 95 Python tests and four layout tests passing, plus a 100,000-person synthetic hierarchy benchmark.

events.promptExcerpt: Begin build
events.title: Build the temporal discovery core
events.outcome: Built a SQLite engine and command-line interface with versioned ingestion, temporal queries, baselines, investigations, and evidence exports. Recorded 71 tests passing and nine of nine demo checks on authored fixtures.

events.promptExcerpt: Continue development
events.title: Add local models and a browser workspace
events.outcome: Added a browser workspace, local-model extraction and embeddings, dense and hybrid retrieval, backups, and installable distributions without a paid API dependency. Recorded 121 tests, clean offline installation, local inference, and desktop/mobile browser verification.

events.promptExcerpt: Continue production and builds
events.title: Package v0.2 for offline installation
events.outcome: Added an offline installer, resumable capture, export concurrency limits, crash recovery, and stricter validation. The final report recorded 217 passing tests, one privilege-dependent skip, and verified clean installation and background CSV export.

events.promptExcerpt: Can you build out the synthetic dataset to 10,000
events.title: Expand the synthetic organization to 10,000 people
events.outcome: Loaded 10,000 people, 76,680 synthetic messages, and 45 organizational units while preserving existing records and history. Recorded 114 tests passing and browser navigation verification.

events.promptExcerpt: when zoomed out it shows general departments and groups but zooming in allows you to see all the way down to an individual connection and position level.
events.title: Navigate from departments to individual connections
events.outcome: Added semantic zoom from departments and groups through reporting branches to positions and connections, with breadcrumbs and evidence markers. Recorded 121 backend and 21 frontend tests passing.

events.promptExcerpt: Push for next build.
events.title: Add capacity planning and parity checks in v0.3
events.outcome: Added hardware sizing, nine modeled scenarios, a live Elasticsearch parity runner, and offline MCP/geometry bundles. The final report recorded 269 passing tests, one privilege-dependent skip, and verified clean installations; modeled scenarios were planning evidence.

events.promptExcerpt: Contnue build, and please greatly polish surface level identification, usability, and robust interfaces.
events.title: Polish the analyst workspace
events.outcome: Added a responsive dark interface, snapshot navigation, graph controls, clearer provenance, protected drafts, and restored investigations. Recorded 145 tests plus offline installation and desktop/mobile workflow verification.

events.promptExcerpt: Continue the build, scan for any inefficiencies, issues, roadblocks, and build custom solutions to them.
events.title: Audit correctness and remove repeated work in v0.4
events.outcome: Addressed ingestion integrity, deadlines, aggregation completeness, and packaging, while removing repeated parsing, duration storage, and CSV rereads. The final report recorded 325 passing tests and one skip; a 10,000-generated-row benchmark reported identical answers, 1.34–4.84× speedups, and 94% lower count-only allocations.

events.promptExcerpt: It needs to be smoother, and it needs to have seamless scrolling
events.title: Smooth chart movement and continuous loading
events.outcome: Added smoother zoom, continuous loading, and preserved scroll position. Recorded 66 tests and a production build passing, with browser verification.

events.promptExcerpt: Polish, remove fluf, remove anything that deviates from the prompt.
events.title: Focus the interface on the research workflow
events.outcome: Removed invented branding, slogans, duplicate headings, and visual clutter while preserving the core GraphRAG workflows. Recorded 39 checks plus desktop, mobile, and offline installation verification.

events.promptExcerpt: Build
events.title: Harden export and recovery behavior in v0.5
events.outcome: Fixed Windows metadata polling, added export progress diagnostics and ingestion locks, and verified concurrent exports and recovery after abrupt worker termination. The final report recorded 361 passing tests, one skip, and two successful offline installations.

events.promptExcerpt: I want more connections at further scrolls, and have the default be zoom not scroll, and have mouse-over have information
events.title: Reveal more connections and hover details
events.outcome: Made wheel input default to zoom and expanded visible connections through 30, 80, and 200 people as zoom increased. Added person, group, and reporting-link hover details; recorded 85 tests and a build passing.

events.promptExcerpt: Make it so that live as you type, there are animations that show the connections being built, the evidence being connected, and nodes highlighting for illustration of what is going on
events.title: Animate connections while the analyst types
events.outcome: Added live relationship animation, source-evidence connections, highlighted nodes, click-to-trace support, and reduced-motion behavior. Recorded 168 tests passing and a rebuilt package with offline installation verification.

events.promptExcerpt: Complete those
events.title: Prepare the live validation handoff
events.outcome: Built and verified a live execution kit and completed source preflight for the next validation stage. This milestone prepared execution; it did not establish measured multi-million-record capacity.
events.promptContext: Context summary: the request referred to live Elasticsearch/Kibana and multi-million-record validation identified after v0.5.

events.promptExcerpt: Can you please remove all AI tells, remove all 'fluff', make it have a sleek interface that walks you through the search step by step
events.title: Refine discovery into a guided interface
events.outcome: Reorganized the interface into Equipment → Specification → Results, removed slogans and exposed diagnostics, and refined the mobile layout while retaining offline operation. The final report recorded 103 passing checks.

events.promptExcerpt: it asks if you want to import a dataset, or if you want to view synthetic dataset.
events.title: Preview a dataset before saving it
events.outcome: Added an import-or-synthetic chooser and an animated six-step walkthrough covering dataset size, people, fields, quality, and graph preview before saving. Included a review checkpoint, replay, and workspace resume; recorded 144 backend and 99 frontend tests passing.

events.promptExcerpt: Add a tab on the left with program instructions
events.title: Add program instructions in the sidebar
events.outcome: Added an Instructions tab with a quick start, workflows, local-model guidance, troubleshooting, and shortcuts. Recorded desktop/mobile verification and 30 tests passing.

events.promptExcerpt: run a simulation of what you expect would happen, and build with that information, without actually simulating
events.title: Use a static scale forecast to guide v0.6
events.outcome: Used static reasoning to add normalization disk/byte limits, reject oversized exports before worker launch, and fetch only requested fields for narrow CSVs. The final report recorded 119 focused checks; no scale simulation or performance measurement was performed.

events.promptExcerpt: make it a little clearer what the 'next step' should be with green buttons prompting for continuance.
events.title: Animate the workflow and clarify the next step
events.outcome: Added automatic stages, gradual node highlights and connecting lines, playback controls, and green next-step buttons. Added recovery behavior and accurate group totals; recorded 158 backend and 121 frontend tests passing.

events.promptExcerpt: Build a much larger dataset to see connections.
events.title: Create a guided exploration of a larger synthetic graph
events.outcome: Added a Start here walkthrough from question to connections, evidence, comparison, and notes, alongside 1,281 synthetic entities, 5,125 active relationships, and six snapshots. Recorded 157 Python and 42 frontend checks passing, plus offline Windows package verification.

events.timeBasis: Publication window: session start through successful deployment, not the end of the full conversation.
events.title: Publish all nine projects and research papers
events.promptKind: Exact excerpts from prompts within the publication session
events.promptExcerpt:
Can you please add all of these to my website's projects, maintaining the current boomer rawlings visual themese

Make sure that my github has all of the projects as well

And I need Masters quality papers for each of them, including the ones I haven't started with a plan and roadmap,  but with a clear disclaimer that they are projected solutions, and completion and implementation hasn't began
events.outcome: Published one overview, nine project pages, five source-derived browser demos, and nine papers totaling 82 pages. Projects 06–09 entered the collection as research proposals with plans and roadmaps; implementation had not begun. The source release and website deployment were verified.
events.context: Editorial project scope: P01 organizational sensemaking; P02 conversational 311 analytics; P03 semantic discovery; P04 organizational knowledge graphs; P05 GraphRAG discovery; P06 agentic retrieval; P07 efficient agentic RAG; P08 capability benchmarks; P09 core-to-edge validation. P06–P09 are research proposals; implementation had not begun.

events.title: Make the showcase intuitive
events.promptExcerpt: Make it look far more modern, less like AI slop, less fluff, clearer workflows, and and INTUITIVE animations and workflow
events.outcome: Reworked the showcase around case → steps → sources → findings, with animated playback, an evidence drawer, search, keyboard controls, and reduced-motion support. The recorded result included 13-case workflow checks and desktop/mobile verification.
